Migration of the Campus Portal to the Munich Scientific Network (MWN)
For security reasons, the Campus Portal for doctoral candidates is now only accessible via the Munich Scientific Network (MWN). Access from outside this network requires a VPN connection. Please see our FAQs for access instructions and options if you do not have an LMU user ID.
